Description: Victoria Maseko and Damian Maseko have a private phone call and emotional exchange in the Dining room, involving Annie Beaumont's situation, family relationships, and their differing views on the future.
Location: Dining room（Dining room）
Key Information:
  - Victoria Maseko has informed her mother that they are currently at the Galley villa and proactively asks her mother not to call again to avoid making Annie Beaumont feel betrayed.
  - Victoria Maseko confirms that she has told her mother the truth about Annie Beaumont, emphasizing that she does not want to lie to her.
  - The conversation clearly states that Annie Beaumont is in financial and life difficulty and may have come seeking help only because she had no other way out.
  - Victoria Maseko believes Annie Beaumont will not stay here for long and promises she will speak with her personally.
  - Damian Maseko expresses unease and rejection about Annie Beaumont intruding into their lives and hopes to maintain a world of just the two of them with Victoria Maseko.
  - Victoria Maseko explicitly raises, for the first time, ideas about the future, living together, and even starting a family, but Damian Maseko shows clear avoidance and hesitation.
  - In the later part of the conversation, Damian Maseko notices that Victoria Maseko is still wearing an item with symbolic meaning, which makes him uneasy and doubtful.
  - A knock at the front door interrupts the conversation, and Victoria Maseko decides to go check the visitor.
Characters:
  [Victoria Maseko（Victoria）] Person No. 7.
    · Has informed her mother about Annie Beaumont's situation and asks her mother to avoid direct involvement.
    · Tries to maintain balance between Annie Beaumont and Damian Maseko.
    · Holds expectations for long-term planning in the relationship.
    · Goes to check after the front door is knocked.
  [Damian Maseko（Damian Maseko）] Person No. 8.
    · Feels uneasy and resistant about Annie Beaumont's presence.
    · Expresses a strong desire to keep a world of just the two of them with Victoria Maseko.
    · Shows an avoidant attitude when Victoria Maseko brings up family and future topics.
    · Notices that Victoria Maseko is still wearing an item with special meaning and becomes suspicious about it.
  [Annie Beaumont（Annie）] Not present in this node, but one of the core figures in the conversation.
    · Is explicitly mentioned as being in financial and life difficulty.
    · Her arrival is believed not to be a long-term arrangement.
